dimensions.assessment: Affects North Pacific Research Board members, administrative staff, and researchers involved in Alaska fisheries and marine ecosystems.
dimensions.evidence: adds to the board one additional member to represent Alaska Natives

dimensions.assessment: Makes administrative adjustments to board composition, term limits, and operating expense percentages without sweeping economic disruption.
dimensions.evidence: Board members appointed under subparagraphs (N) and (O) shall serve for 3-year terms

dimensions.assessment: Adjusts administrative cost caps and funding allocation flexibility for existing research funds rather than appropriating new federal funds.
dimensions.evidence: the 15 percent cap on funds to provide support for the North Pacific Research Board... shall be waived

dimensions.assessment: Amends prior appropriations acts to change board member seats, apply term limits, and modify administrative spending caps.
dimensions.evidence: Section 401(e) of the Department of the Interior and Related Agencies Appropriations Act, 1998... is amended

dimensions.assessment: Includes permanent board composition rules alongside a temporary four-year waiver of administrative caps.
dimensions.evidence: ending on the date that is 4 years after such date of enactment, the 15 percent cap... shall be waived

missing_information: Exact dollar values of total research grant funds handled by the board
importance_detail.rationale: Modifies North Pacific Research Board membership to include an Alaska Native representative with subsistence experience, sets term limits, and provides temporary or conditional waivers/increases to administrative expense caps.
